tracks.title: Live With That
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
Now I see the light
Tried to close my eyes
Cursed with perfect sight
Nothing turning right

[Verse 1]
Pullin' up and poppin' out and saying how I feel
I've been runnin' through the budget just to keep my status still
Always calculated gestures, it's a fundamental skill
If I stop to catch a breath then I might lose my whole appeal, yeah
Hard to keep the focus when I'm chasin' down a thrill
Got a set of polished optics giving bitter coated pills
Tryna master all the nuance, I'm a product of my will
I'll be climbing up the mountain just to stare at all the hills
It's a quiet desperation, it's a sharpening of steel
Just to cut through all the static and the way it make me feel
Tryin not to let the silence do the thing that makes it nil
Self loathing every day like I'm programmed for the kill

[Chorus]
Now I see the light
Tried to close my eyes
Cursed with perfect sight
Nothing turning right
Living in the in-between
Of how it really is and how I thought it'd be
I don't know how to want it back
Guess I gotta live with that

[Verse 2]
Pullin' up again with the pressure in my chest
Wins are feeling rented, every promise under test
Budget full of damage but I wear it like a crest
If you see me slow down, watch the way I'm moving next
Noticing the colors fade
Every year it gets a bit more gray
Losing all the parts of me that stayed
Watching everything I built just fray
Tryna find a single reason not to be afraid
But the doubt just keeps on pulling me away

[Bridge]
Feel like every single day's another letter
That I'm writing but I'm never gonna send
And I don't know if I'm getting any better
'Cause I'll break before I ever, bend
If the demons call, don't answer
If the floor drops out, move faster
Stone-faced, that's the way I gotta be
'Cause I never wanna see repeat disaster
Now it's just a foreign life
And a life I never led

[Chorus]
Now I see the light
Tried to close my eyes
Cursed with perfect sight
Nothing turning right
Living in the in-between
Of how it really is and how I thought it'd be
I don't know how to want it back
Guess I gotta live with that

[Outro]
'Cause I'll break before I ever bend
In a life I never led
Guess I gotta live with that

tracks.title: Nowhere Fast
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Watching the sun as it cuts through the curtains
Chasing the phantoms that stuck being certain
Searching for meaning in time that I wasted
The best way to cope is to change how you frame it
Changed all the walls, I could swap the foundation
And somehow I'll never completely replace it
But it doesn't hurt if I try, cause let's face it
The only alternatives fill me with hatred

[Chorus]
Always going nowhere fast
I wish I thought that this pain won't last
Things were good, then it all went bad
I gave my all and got nothing back
Wishing I could rewind the track
Memories slipping into the black
Things were good, and I want that back
So sick of going nowhere fast

[Verse 2]
Before I can process, before I can speak
Life knocks me down just to watch as I bleed
It must be a sadist that revels in torment
With gravity keeping me stuck in its orbit
But I bought the ticket and stood in the queue
I know in the end it's the reason I grew
Treat all my scars like they're badges of honor
Cause they coincide with a time I was stronger
But that times not coming back

[Chorus]
Always going nowhere fast
I wish I thought that this pain won't last
Things were good, then it all went bad
I gave my all and got nothing back
Wishing I could rewind the track
Memories slipping into the black
Things were good, and I want that back
So sick of going nowhere fast

[Bridge]
There's a room in my head I don't open
Same chair, same light through the blinds
I keep paying the rent on a house I don't live in
And calling it peace of mind
So I'm tearing the floorboards up
Selling the wood for scrap
Nothing left in here worth saving
Nothing I want back

[Chorus]
Guess I'm going nowhere fast
But I don't think that this pain will last
Nothing's good, but it's not all bad
I gave my all then I took it back
Done trying to rewind the track
Memories burning up, turned to ash
Things were good, I don't need that back
So done with going nowhere fast

[Outro]
Going nowhere fast (x2)
Things were good

tracks.title: Safe Place
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
Wishing I could (x4)

[Verse 1]
Trust another soul but that's a fairy tale
Waking up and hopping out my bed is just a form of hell
Pace the floor cause my anxiety and me ain't mixing well
Mind's a haunted house and I'm the ghost up in the shell
Time to face the music, know that I can take it
But I'm sick of all these pills that always get regurgitated
Got a pair of hands that shaking, they're my ride or dies
Cause all I ever got is me up in this life of mine

[Chorus]
Locked in my head, that's the only safe place
When I'm reaching out my fingers always end up on a blade
Built this cage myself, always in the same state
Only one that got the key I might just take it to the grave

[Verse 2]
Seen the text, left it on read, no reply
Cut the loose ties quick, don't ask me why
I don't do "I miss you"
I don't do the small talk
Show me fake love, can't say sorry now your calls blocked
Phone on DND, let it ring off
Been around enough to know when it's my time to get gone
Every bridge I burned before just made me room to breathe
Now I keep the circle smaller so there's only room for me

[Chorus]
Locked in my head, that's the only safe place
When I'm reaching out my fingers always end up on a blade
Built this cage myself, always in the same state
Only one that got the key I might just take it to the grave
So I'm stuck in my head, I know there's no other way
I can only numb the pain when there's nothing left to say
I won't crack under the weight, I'll just suffer through the days
You can only bleed so long until it dries up all the veins

[Verse 3]
They say "we got you," but the line goes dead
Just echoes bouncing inside my head
Fool me once, shame on them, like the old adage
Fool me twice, burn it down and leave em in the past tense
Every open hand ends up empty when it's over
Every safe haven up in smoke when it's colder
Built these walls up way too high for anyone to climb
And I play the judge and jury, serve the sentence in my mind

[Chorus]
Locked in my head, that's the only safe place
When I'm reaching out my fingers always end up on a blade
Built this cage myself, always in the same state
Only one that got the key I might just take it to the grave
So I'm stuck in my head, I know there's no other way
I can only numb the pain when there's nothing left to say
I won't crack under the weight, I'll just suffer through the days
I can only bleed so long until it dries up all the veins

tracks.title: What Can I Say?
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
Everybody sleeps while I'm up
Go figure

[Verse 1]
Everybody sleeps while I'm up, go figure
Pacing out the steps as the tension grows thicker
Staring at the wall tryna find a faint glimmer
Shadows in the room make the vision feel dimmer
Feeling real low, down low, I simmer
Always on the edge, I'm a lost cause sinner
Try to play the game but I'm not no winner
And I keep the same Friends like the name Dave Schwimmer

[Chorus]
I know they're going out of their way
If they love to feel hate, what the fuck can I say to 'em?
I know they're probably trapped in their pain
And they're feeling some way, tryna make me feel pain too
They wanna take me out of my frame
Tryna get in my brain, but I swerve and switch lanes ooh
That's prolly cause I always need space
While I do my own thing, you should do your own thing too

[Verse 2]
Sub-zero heart so it makes me shiver
Floating in the dark in this frozen river
And if you wonder why, well you might consider
The weight of every truth that I can't deliver
I've got a lot of things that I still remember
Thoughts get dark but I can't surrender
Messages always get returned to sender
Cold in my soul like it's late December

[Chorus]
I know they're going out of their way
If they love to feel hate, what the fuck can I say to 'em?
I know they're probably trapped in their pain
And they're feeling some way, tryna make me feel pain too
They wanna take me out of my frame
Wanna get in my brain, but I swerve and switch lanes ooh
That's prolly cause I always need space
While I do my own thing, you should do your own thing too

[Verse 3]
Sometimes I wish I was someone different
Feel myself slipping and I just dismiss it
Terrified thinking that I might exhibit
Telltale signs of a mind grown distant
I'm turning off the noise that's keeping me in chains
I'm washing out the dirt tryna clean away the stains
I'm learning how to breathe in the heaviest of air
While picking up and carrying the crosses that I bear

[Chorus]
I know they're going out of their way
If they love to feel hate, what the fuck can I say to 'em?
I know they're probably trapped in their pain
And they're feeling some way, tryna make me feel pain too
They wanna take me out of my frame
Wanna get in my brain, but I swerve and switch lanes ooh
That's prolly cause I always need space
While I do my own thing, you should do your own thing too

[Outro]
Everybody sleeps while I'm up
Go figure
Everybody sleeps while I'm up (x2)
Go figure

tracks.title: Forever
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sick of the emotions getting under my skin
Feeling the procrastination pulling me in
Skip the pleasantries, I cut straight to the bone
Of all the things I'll never be: a snake is the most
Drain the batteries, tryna find my spark
Always doing me, I'm never playing a part
I don't need invitations if I'm making the call
Rather end up in a grave than end up nothing at all

[Pre-Chorus]
Every minute is currency and I'm bleeding it away
I'm pushing hard on the board with nothing left to say
And if the consequence is steep, I'm paying the debt
Because

[Chorus]
I'd hate to wake up later on with any regret
For all the things I never did or things that I left unsaid
Yeah, I don't wanna think I should've known it all better
'Cause once the time has passed me by, it's faded forever

[Verse 2]
We sit around and wait for luck to deal us a hand
I'm flipping tables in my mind and making demands
I use the arrogance I built to cover the cracks
I break the mirrors in the room so I can't look back
It isn't dominance, it's just a fear of still
If I don't manufacture chaos, the silence will

[Pre-Chorus]
Every minute is currency and I'm bleeding it away
I'm pushing hard on the board with nothing left to say
And if the consequence is steep, I'm paying the debt
Because

[Chorus]
I'd hate to wake up later on with any regret
For all the things I never did or things that I left unsaid
Yeah, I don't wanna think I should've known it all better
'Cause once the time has passed me by, it's faded forever

[Bridge]
No rehearsal, no repeat, and the curtain is torn
I take the damage and the heat while perfecting my form
The hesitation is a trap, a quiet decay
Ripping out the pages from my story I hate
I'd rather break up all the glass than keep it inside
I'd rather step into the blast than find place to hide

[Chorus]
I'd hate to wake up later on with any regret
For all the things I never did or things that I left unsaid
Yeah, I don't wanna think I should've known it all better
'Cause once the time has passed me by, it's faded forever

tracks.title: Comfortable
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The seasons change, and all the days
Been feeling super lonely since the winter came
I'm finding ways to turn the page
Of the story that I'm writing, but it's hard to be okay
When you're always stuck in the past
And wishing you appreciated all the times that you had
While you had them
But that's how it goes
I'm trying not to blame myself cause I didn't know

[Chorus]
But now I'm trying not to get too comfortable
Cause nothing ever stays the same
One day something's there in life
And then the next you see it getting replaced
I keep on losing sleep because
I'll never get the chance to fix my mistakes
And though the past can't be undone
I'll keep on tryna right the wrongs that I've made

[Verse 2]
I never needed anyone to fix my problems
I just wanted somebody that I could talk with
But people seem to throw me to the side so often
And they don't even realize they're making my coffin
So how can I pretend that I cleared my conscience
With all the skeletons that are in my closet, yeah
I'm trying not to feel no ways
But that's just how I get some days

[Bridge]
I used to close my eyes and imagine
I was anybody else but me
But then I realized that I'm wasting the time
That I should focus on the things I can reach

[Chorus]
And now I'm trying not to get too comfortable
Cause nothing ever stays the same
One day something's there in life
And then the next you see it getting replaced
I keep on losing sleep because
I'll never get the chance to fix my mistakes
And though the past can't be undone
I'll keep on tryna right the wrongs that I've made

tracks.title: Only Human
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wake up every morning with the best intentions
But there's a hundred things already trying to get my attention
So I try to think of anything to ease the tension
But get stuck in these perpetual states of suspension
It's always one step forward and two steps back
I try my best but I still fall flat sometimes

[Chorus]
I'm only human
Just like everybody else, I don't know what I'm doing
Man it's hard to read between the lines
But here's one rule that you need in life
If it doesn't bring you peace of mind
Then it's something you should leave behind

[Verse 2]
It takes too long to feel some calm
When things go wrong in the life I made
Got sweaty palms and all these thoughts
Sound like alarms at the start of the day
I'm chasing change but everything I see just seems to stay the same
So I just wait and watch the rain that pours on me in tidal waves
It's one step forward and two steps back
I try my best but I still fall flat sometimes

[Chorus]
I'm only human
Just like everybody else, I don't know what I'm doing
Man it's hard to read between the lines
But here's one rule that you need in life
If it doesn't bring you peace of mind
Then it's something you should leave behind

[Bridge]
Leave it in the rear view, somewhere never near you
So it never brings you pain again
And you can shed the tears but they don't deserve to hear
When you take your broken wings and make amends

[Outro]
HEY!
It's hard to read between the lines
But here's one rule that you need in life
If it doesn't bring you peace of mind
Then it's something you should leave behind

tracks.title: Different
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You memorized my triggers, and swear you can't recall
You make me feel like nothing, then catch me when I fall
You speak in half confessions, leave the rest for me to find
You're fluent in deflection, and any tongue but mine

[Chorus]
I wish you were different, but then you wouldn't be you
If I changed every angle, would I still see something true?
I keep trying to edit, what your heart already drew
I wish you were different, but I'm scared I'd lose you too

[Verse 2]
You always show up late, blame the traffic, change the frame
You joke when I'm shaking, turn my questions into games
You hate it when I'm quiet, but you never want the flood
You kiss the tears off my face, then pretend they were dust

[Chorus]
I wish you were different, but then you wouldn't be you
If I sanded your edges, would I smooth my own out too?
I keep rewriting the ending, like the story can't be true
I wish you were different, but I'm scared I'd lose you too

[Bridge]
What if you woke up kind, in all the ways you're not?
Would I still recognize the stranger in my thoughts
If every little thing I find is stitched into your name
Can I hold you and still pray you'll somehow stay the same?

[Chorus]
I wish you were different, but then you wouldn't be you
If I got the perfection, would it feel like something cruel
So I love you and I hate it, how that both can be true
I wish you were different, but I only get this you

tracks.title: Alone
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Happy and I'm sad, I'm always both 'em at the same time
When I'm thinking way too deep, I pull it back and take five
Wavy like a lake tide, staying out of plain sight
Ready when it's game time, but I've been in a grave site
Threw off to the wayside
Fading like a faint light
It's like I'm tryna play dice
Only rolling snake eyes
Stuck up in a daze like
Every day I'm seeing gray skies

[Pre-Chorus]
I'm so fucking tired and I don't have what's required
When it comes to being functional in everyday life
It's like I'm running on a frequency that nobody can dial
And I'm stuck inside a spiral, on a track I'm running miles
My mind is like a riot in this quiet room I'm fightin'
Tryna sit inside the silence, but the crying starts at night
I keep on buying into guidance from a mind that's gone and lifeless
Like I'm dying in the brightness of a life I can't define

[Chorus]
And I don't wanna go outside, and so I'm never out the home
When they're ringing on my line, leave a message at the tone
And I'll never hit them back, cause my hopes are always low
And I'm sick of being judged, so I'd rather be alone
I'm done with all the hurt and the agony
That wanna make me turn to a tragedy
I wish that I could change my reality
When thoughts in my brain keep attacking me

[Verse 2]
I've been thinking about the old me
And all the nights I had with no sleep
I was tryna find out where the roads lead
Always on a search for what my soul need
Looking in from the outside there's a lot they don't see
Mental status downsides, and it's been a slow bleed
Nights are always best when I'm smoking all alone
Fighting off the dread while I be staying on the low
Try to find support so the shade can't say it got me out
Know it's always honest if you're hearing it in Colin's sound

[Chorus]
And I don't wanna go outside, and so I'm never out the home
When they're ringing on my line, leave a message at the tone
And I'll never hit them back, cause my hopes are always low
And I'm sick of being judged, so I'd rather be alone
Done with all the hurt and the agony
That wanna make me turn to a tragedy
I wish that I could change my reality
When thoughts in my brain keep attacking me

[Verse 3]
Weight of being in a world that never loved me back
Chasing down a feeling that I swear I'll never have
Every time I'm getting close It's always just out of my grasp
So I'm laughing at the irony with knives up in my back
Cause I'm the type to hold it and never let it show
And everybody think I'm fine because I suffer on my own
So no one really knows it's underneath the surface so
I've been letting go of everything I thought I used to know
Try to bury all the pain but always feel it in my bones
So I'm digging through the dirt tryna find a place to grow

tracks.title: Rose
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus]
Now I'm watching you go as I'm left here lonely
I wish all the times that we had moved slowly
I'll never forget all the things you told me
Like how I deserve all the love you showed me
But I don't really think that you're replaceable
So how could I accept you're not available?
And I don't think I'll ever just erase it all
When you're the best I ever had, it's why you made me fall

[Verse 1]
I'm like the color of your eyes cause inside, yeah I'm true blue
Thinking how we'll never really talk like we used to
Maybe one day I could find some peace, but it's too soon
Honestly, I'm grateful that there was a time I knew you
Always kept it honest with me, girl, and I was true too
From the very start, now what the fuck I gotta lose you?
Wishing that I could've been the one you wanted more
Cause in every life I live, I'll just be looking for you

[Verse 2]
Now I get your message and I hold and react
Because I know it's probably best for you if I'm in the past
There's still a million things I wish we could be talking about
I'll never lose the little part of me that wants you around

[Bridge]
For the rest of my days, it's kind of insane
I thought it would change, but after the day we met
It just never was the same, could never replace
The time we shared together, it fades but not in my brain
My life will always save you a place, that's ever in case

[Chorus]
Now I'm watching you go as I'm left here lonely
I wish all the times that we had moved slowly
I'll never forget all the things you told me
Like how I deserve all the love you showed me
But I don't really think that you're replaceable
So how could I accept you're not available?
And I don't think I'll ever just erase it all
When you're the best I ever had, it's why you made me fall

tracks.title: More Lonely
tracks.lyrics:
[Chorus]
When I grew up I got more lonely, no new friends I got me only
Lost someone that I held so closely and lost myself on the day she told me
It's time to call this quits and I'm sorry things turned out like this
I hope you know that I'll always miss the times we had and I won't forget ya
But she'll be running back one day when she knows I was always honest
But it's far too late to be making things right for your guilty conscience
Everything that we had is a skeleton buried deep in my closet
And I cannot look back now cause I don't really have no option

[Post-Chorus]
Everything come full circle one day
So we all gonna get what's coming our way
And I ain't no saint
But I think I'll be good cause I know I been great

[Verse]
I ain't gonna miss when they need me for the crunch time
Almost got the win so I shoot it for the dub like
If I see em' on the front line
They just want the beef, man it isn't even lunchtime
Going in, yeah I'm never getting tongue tied
Ready with the pen and I'm clever with the punchlines
Even if it's bad man I try to find the upside
I don't need a map cause I'm going where the sun shines

[Pre-Chorus]
It's a simple equation: you get what you give
Gotta give what you taking, yeah
Think before you say shit
Try not to waste any brain you came with

[Chorus]
When I grew up I got more lonely, no new friends I got me only
Lost someone that I held so closely and lost myself on the day she told me
It's time to call this quits and I'm sorry things turned out like this
I hope you know that I'll always miss the times we had and I won't forget ya
But she'll be running back one day when she knows I was always honest
But it's far too late to be making things right for your guilty conscience
Everything that we had is a skeleton buried deep in my closet
And I cannot look back now cause I don't really have no option

tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
Lookin' at my guilty conscience
Try to look away but that ain't no option
Imma change one day, I promise
Gotta get rid of my guilty conscience

[Verse 1]
Used to pray at night but my faith was fading
Chasing all my dreams while my mind was racing
Told myself I'd change but I kept on waiting
Drowning in the choices that I kept on making

See the ones I love and I'm feeling all the weight now
Every bridge I burned I wish I tried to put the flames out
Can't rewind the clock or escape this name now
Never could've seen this is how it would've played out

[Chorus]
Lookin' at my guilty conscience
Try to look away but that ain't no option
Imma change one day, I promise
Gotta get rid of my guilty conscience
Lookin' at my guilty conscience
Try to look away but that ain't no option
Imma change one day, I promise

[Verse 2]
They don't know the half
Of the things that make me sad
That I carry on my back here daily
I don't know how long it's gonna last
But it's simple, do the math
And I know it's gonna pass like
B-B-B-B-Brady

[Verse 3]
Maybe all the mistakes that I made didn't make me
Back in all the times when my life stayed rainy
Had to find a way when the path seemed hazy

Wait for anyone to save me
Sometimes in life think I might go crazy
But I can never quit and let the world erase me

[Chorus]
Lookin' at my guilty conscience
Try to look away but that ain't no option

Lookin' at my guilty conscience

tracks.title: Holding On
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There's a voice in my head that won't let me rest
Keeps running the tape of my worst and my best
I'm somewhere between who I am and the show
Tired and scared and I can't let it go
I've got routines built to keep myself steady
A version of calm that's locked and it's ready
But underneath all of the noise and the motion
Something is moving like waves in an ocean

[Pre-Chorus]
It's a long way down from the person I'm being
Ignoring the things that I'm actually seeing
I'm overcommitted I'm too far in
While I'm hiding the panic that's under my skin
It's heavy lifting to keep up face
When you paint yourself in a different way
I'm running my lines till the ribbon gets thinner
Trying to survive like that makes me a winner

[Chorus]
Well I guess I just don't know it all
My battery gets overdrawn
I'm leaning hard against the wall
Trying not to slip — fall
I'm just like shadows on the lawn
Waiting for the break of dawn
Tell myself that it won't be long
So I'll just keep on holding on

[Verse 2]
Carefully stalling the ceiling is falling
The pressure is calling and I'm barely crawling
The panic is rising I'm over-disguising
And I start despising the way I'm comprising myself
And that's the honest truth
If I always did what felt like safe I'd never leave my room
Where I'd stare up into empty space and lay up in my gloom
And it's hard to break a cycle when it feels like part of you
But I'm doing what I can do hollowed out and ran through
Version of a man who never had a plan to
Navigate the nightmares try to keep a light spare
Never showing I'm scared feelings never fight fair

[Pre-Chorus]
Long way down from the person I'm being
Ignoring the things that I'm actually seeing
I'm overcommitted I'm too far in
While I'm hiding the panic that's under my skin
It's heavy lifting to keep up face
When you paint yourself in a different way
I'm running my lines till the ribbon gets thinner
Trying to survive like that makes me a winner

[Chorus]
Well I guess I just don't know it all
My battery gets overdrawn
I'm leaning hard against the wall
Trying not to slip — fall
I'm just like shadows on the lawn
Waiting for the break of dawn
Tell myself that it won't be long
So I'll just keep on holding on

tracks.title: Nothing to Prove
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Started from the bottom, used to contemplate my worth
Felt like every setback was the universe at first
Had to lose it all before I learned to stay the course
Now I never fold cause I remember all the hurt
Used to second guess myself and doubt if things would turn
Blocking all the noise I let my actions do the work
All the doubt they had in me just added to my nerve
Waiting for the day I get redemption I deserve

[Chorus]
Doing my best even if I might lose
Cause unless you're myself I got nothing to prove
And this life goes fast when you're watching time move
Thinking everything's changed, but I guess I did too
To the ones I got now know I'll always stay true
Everyone that talk down, give a fuck about you
I'm reminding myself only thing I knows true
When the going gets tough then you find a way through

[Verse 2]
Yeah I'm ballin' check the scoreboard, but I got some words first
Been fucked up so many times before and got the worst nerve
Now I never trip on it if I did what I could first
If it's meant to be then everything about it should work
Trusting in the process even when the future's unclear
Took me time to learn to let it go and brave the frontier
Keep on taking steps to find a purpose till it appears
Stop trying to be perfect it's not worth it and that's sincere

[Verse 3]
If you wanna make it through you gotta persevere
You might fall and wonder if the end is worth the tears that you shed
While learning how you'd ever face your fears
Looking back, it's nothing when your focus crystal clear
Don't give up you might be closer than you really think
You might turn the corner realize you're on the brink
Of everything you're working for so let the feeling sink in
Trust yourself, and if you know the words it's time to sing them

[Chorus]
Doing my best even if I might lose
Cause unless you're myself I got nothing to prove
And this life goes fast when you're watching time move
Thinking everything's changed, but I guess I did too
To the ones I got now know I'll always stay true
Everyone that talk down, give a fuck about you
I'm reminding myself only thing I knows true
When the going gets tough then you find a way through

tracks.title: Thnks Fr Frgtting Me
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Finally seeing all the writing up on the wall
How I built you up high, it turned to watching you fall
Every red flag turned to colors that I tried to paint you
Yeah, I tried to look away til the worst of it came true
Convinced that what we had was worth the fight
Always turned a blind eye and I said it was fine
But the version of you that I loved, it never was honest
Can't believe it took so long to figure out it was toxic

[Chorus]
So goodbye for one last time
Thanks for forgetting me, guess I wasn't all that great
I thought that what we had was real
And I still don't know why
But now all the memories never gonna seem the same
I wish they'd all just disappear
But I know they can't
Yeah, yeah

[Verse 2]
And it's got me feeling lonely
Man, thank God that I have my homies
Took me for a whirl, I should probably make that pearl
Now you're just someone in life that used to know me
Thought that I was sure about the person that you were
But you played me and it worked and the real you showing
Ain't no open doors cause the bridges that you burn
Made sure all the ones that were there were closing

[Bridge]
Do you ever think about me now that I'm gone?
And will you ever hear me singing all the words in the song?
Or do I live inside the part up in your brain where it's dark?
Did you forget about the way you tried to break me apart?
I hope you know I would've given everything, the moon and the stars
And all you gave me in the end was just a lot of these scars
And there's a lot that I could say but I ain't even gon' start
Cause I don't wanna make you hurt and that's what set me apart
From you always

[Chorus]
So goodbye for one last time
Thanks for forgetting me, guess I wasn't all that great
I thought that what we had was real
And I still don't know why
But now all the memories never gonna seem the same
I wish they'd all just disappear
But I know they can't
